summary: Build digital productivity and personal knowledge management skills with practical tools, templates, and workflows. Enrol to improve focus and follow-through.
lede: Digital productivity and personal knowledge management help professionals organize tasks, capture useful information, and retrieve it when needed. This training is for professionals working across digital tools who need a reliable way to manage priorities, notes, and follow-through. Learners practice task triage with the Eisenhower Matrix, organize knowledge with PARA, create linked notes, plan weekly work with Kanban, and use digital tools and automation for capture and reminders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in digital environments and need a more reliable way to manage tasks, notes, and priorities. It suits roles that depend on execution discipline, information retrieval, and cross-functional follow-through.
prerequisites: Learners should bring a laptop, access to email and calendar tools, and working knowledge of basic file and note organization. Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Notion, or a comparable task and notes platform will help, but the course will show practical workflows that can be adapted to most digital environments.
